```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(flextable)
library(officer)

```

```{r table}
#| tbl-cap: HRs and C-Index for the any-PCa and aggressive-PCa models. HR~SD~ is the increase in HR for a one-standard-deviation increase in PHS. HR~80/20~ is the HR between the top quintile and the bottom quintile of PHS. HR~80/50~ is the HR between the top quintile and the median PHS (30-70th percentile). HR~95/50~ is the HR between the top 5% and the median PHS (30-70th percentile). 95% confidence intervals are based on 999 bootstraps.
table_coxph <- read_tsv("figures_and_tables/table_coxph.tsv")
border <- fp_border_default()

subheaders = c("Any-stage PCa", "Aggressive PCa")
rows = c(1, 4)
update <- table_coxph[, -1]
update <-
  update %>%
  mutate(subheader = NA_character_) %>%
  select(subheader, Cohort:`C-Index`)
for (i in seq_along(rows)) {
  start = rows[i]-1
  update <- rbind(
    update[0:start,],
    c(subheaders[i], rep_len(NA, ncol(update) - 1)),
    update[rows[i]:nrow(update),]
  ) %>%
  print()
}


ft <- flextable(update) %>%
      fontsize(size = 9, part = "all") %>%
      font(part = "all", fontname = "Helvetica Neue") %>% 
      bold(part = "body", j = "subheader") %>%
      width(j = c("subheader", "Cohort", "Cases", "HR_SD", "HR80/20", "HR80/50", "HR95/50", "C-Index"), width = c(.3, .4, .4, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1)) %>%
      mk_par( 
        j = "HR_SD", 
        part = "header",
        value = as_paragraph(
          "HR", as_sub("SD")
        )
      ) %>%
      mk_par( 
        j = "HR80/20",
        part = "header",
        value = as_paragraph(
          "HR", as_sub("80/20")
        )
      ) %>%
      mk_par( 
        j = "HR80/50",
        part = "header",
        value = as_paragraph(
          "HR", as_sub("80/50")
        )
      ) %>%
      mk_par( 
        j = "HR95/50",
        part = "header",
        value = as_paragraph(
          "HR", as_sub("95/50")
        )
      ) %>%
      merge_h_range(i = 1, j1 = "subheader", j2 = "`C-Index`") %>%
      merge_h_range(i = 4, j1 = "subheader", j2 = "`C-Index`") %>%
      mk_par( 
        j = "subheader",
        part = "header",
        value = as_paragraph(
          ""
        )
      ) %>%
      theme_vanilla()

ft
```
